title: Omnichannel and Indication Expansion in BioPharma
summary: This document highlights the key RA trends for 2025, focusing on digital transformation, regulatory harmonization, personalized medicine and advance therapies, regulatory agility, and fast-tracking considerations.
body_markdown:
This case study highlights how RCM Life Sciences supported a global biopharma organization during indication expansion and commercial growth, helping align operational workflows, reporting, systems support, and cross-functional execution across multiple programs.
